description.content: Wired Clients are Wired devices connected to a Juniper switch monitored or managed by Mist.

Count wired clients for a site, optionally grouped by the `distinct` field and filtered by MAC address, switch port, VLAN, and time range. Use [Count Org Wired Clients](/#operations/countOrgWiredClients) to count wired clients across the organization.
